title: Editor context menu sub-menus do not reliably expand on hover
body:
### Tested versions

Tested and replicated in:

Godot v4.7.1.stable.mono - Freedesktop SDK 24.08 (Flatpak runtime) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 155H (22 threads) - 30.76 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

Godot v4.6.3.stable.mono - Freedesktop SDK 24.08 (Flatpak runtime) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 155H (22 threads) - 30.76 GiB memory

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable.mono - Freedesktop SDK 24.08 (Flatpak runtime) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 155H (22 threads) - 30.76 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When navigating context menus with sub-menus (e.g. Filesystem right-click context menu), it is not possible to reliably raise those sub-menus with hover (e.g. the "Create new" menu often refuses to display).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Launch Godot 4.7.1
2. In file system explorer, right click on a directory
3. Hover over "Create new"
4. Repeat a few times, sometimes it refuses to display from the start, sometimes it takes a few tries.
5. (optional) The issue "fixes" itself after a few tries / after clicking into the viewport. This however also isn't very reliable.

#### View showcasing the issue

This video showcases the issue with other menus (note that in this example the filesystem context menu I described above works as expected, but the others dont):

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6f486ff1-d87e-484e-b842-538f63ae5c99

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A, applied to all projects, even newly created / empty ones.
